title: 3 AL/BC testing patterns from an external BC testing expert's blog (Luc van Vugt, fluxxus.nl)
summary: Three AL testing patterns from an external BC expert's blog are documented as best practices: using events to exclude invalid table relations in tests, committing shared test fixtures before lazy initialization, and using Assert.IsFalse for boolean checks instead of asserterror.
key_points: Table Relation Test's OnAfterRemoveTableRelation event hook for excluding relations during test setup
Shared fixture data requires explicit Commit() to persist across tests, otherwise changes roll back silently
Assert.IsFalse is the correct assertion for boolean checks, not asserterror wrapped around Assert.IsTrue
Patterns verified against current BCApps source code and cleared for inclusion in quality rules
Three candidates were included; one was rejected as unverifiable in supported versions, and two others were excluded as too narrow or obsolete
quote: mined from a source outside CURABIS itself: Luc van Vugt's fluxxus.nl, a long-running blog by a BC/NAV developer
